translations.fr: Mon cœur, quand est-ce que tu viens me voir ? Que Dieu te bénisse et t'accorde Sa grâce, mon enfant.
translations.es: Mi vida, ¿cuándo vas a venir? Que Dios te bendiga y te acompañe siempre, hijo mío.
translations.it: Gioia mia, quando verrai a trovarmi? Che Dio ti benedica e ti protegga sempre, figlio mio.
translations.en: My precious child, when are you coming to visit? May God bless you and always be pleased with you, my dear.

cultural_notes.meaning: An intense term of endearment for a child/grandchild, referring to them as one's own vital organ.

cultural_notes.literal: May God be pleased with you
cultural_notes.meaning: A traditional parental blessing wishing divine favor, protection, and success upon a loved one.

translations.fr: Que Dieu te protège et te garde toujours auprès de moi, ma fille adorée.
translations.es: Que Dios te me cuide y te conserve siempre a mi lado, mi niña.
translations.it: Che Dio ti protegga e ti tenga sempre al mio fianco, figlia mia.
translations.en: May God protect you and keep you in my life, my dear daughter.

cultural_notes.meaning: A loving prayer asking God to preserve your loved one's life and keep them near you.

translations.fr: Tu me manques tellement, mon enfant ; la maison est toute vide sans toi.
translations.es: Te extraño muchísimo, mi vida; la casa está tan vacía sin ti.
translations.it: Mi manchi tantissimo, tesoro mio; la casa è così vuota senza di te.
translations.en: I miss you so much, my dear; the house feels completely empty without you.

translations.fr: Que Dieu te protège et te fasse réussir dans tes études, mon enfant.

translations.en: May God protect you and grant you success in your studies, my dear.

translations.fr: Qui veut du miel doit supporter la piqûre des abeilles, mon enfant. Tout ce qui est doux demande un peu de patience !
translations.es: Quien quiere miel, mi vida, tiene que aguantar las picaduras de abeja. ¡Las cosas buenas requieren esfuerzo!
translations.it: Chi vuole il miele, tesoro mio, deve sopportare le punture delle api. Le cose belle richiedono pazienza!
translations.en: If you want the sweet honey, my child, you have to put up with a few bee stings. Good things take patience and effort!

cultural_notes.expression: Lli bgha l3sel ysber l9ris n7el
cultural_notes.literal: Whoever wants honey must be patient with bee stings
cultural_notes.meaning: To achieve a sweet reward or success in life, you must be willing to endure hard work or difficulties.

text: {"translations": {"fr": "Regarde-toi, grand comme un palmier, mais tu ne sais toujours pas cuisiner !", "es": "¡Te has puesto tan alto como una palmera, pero todavía no sabes cocinar!", "it": "Sei diventato alto come una palma, ma ancora non sai cucinare!", "en": "Look at you, grown as tall as a palm tree, but you still haven't learned how to cook!"}, "feeling": ["humor", "love"], "cultural_notes": [{"expression": "twil b7al nkhla", "literal": "tall like a palm tree", "meaning": "A affectionate Moroccan idiom used to tease someone who has grown very tall."}], "confidence": "high"}

translations.fr: Regarde-toi, grand comme un palmier, mais tu ne sais toujours pas cuisiner !
translations.es: ¡Te has puesto tan alto como una palmera, pero todavía no sabes cocinar!
translations.it: Sei diventato alto come una palma, ma ancora non sai cucinare!
translations.en: Look at you, grown as tall as a palm tree, but you still haven't learned how to cook!

cultural_notes.meaning: A affectionate Moroccan idiom used to tease someone who has grown very tall.

translations.fr: Oh la prunelle de mes yeux, tu es tout ce que j'ai au monde.
translations.es: Oh mis ojos, tú eres todo lo que tengo en este mundo.
